title.zh: Trezor says mailing breach leaked 67K more users than first thought
title.en: Trezor says mailing breach leaked 67K more users than first thought

current_state.zh: Trezor disclosed that its mailing partner breach actually leaked 67,000 more users than initially reported, bringing the total to over 80,000 and admitting its data-deletion policy was never enforced.
